description: Expression and protein-existence evidence per B. malayi beta-tubulin locus, with a record of which expression resources were reachable
code:
import requests, time, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np
s=requests.Session(); s.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
# 1. Final programmatic attempt at isotype-resolved expression resources
log=[]
try:
    r=s.get("https://parasite.wormbase.org/rest/info/ping",headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"},timeout=20)
    log.append("WBParaSite REST ping: HTTP %d %s"%(r.status_code,r.text[:60]))
except Exception as e: log.append("WBParaSite REST ping: FAILED (%s)"%type(e).__name__)
try:
    r=s.get("https://www.ebi.ac.uk/gxa/json/experiments",timeout=20).json()
    br=[e for e in r.get("experiments",[]) if "rugia" in e.get("experimentalFactors","")+e.get("experimentDescription","")+str(e.get("species",""))]
    log.append("EBI Expression Atlas: %d experiments total, %d mentioning Brugia"%(len(r.get("experiments",[])),len(br)))
except Exception as e: log.append("EBI Expression Atlas: FAILED (%s)"%type(e).__name__)
print("\n".join(log))

# 2. Summary of transcript-level evidence per locus (counts from the executed EST/nucleotide assignment above)
labs=["bma-ben-1\n(Bm4733)","Bm9698\n(Bma-tbb-6)","Bm8661\n(Bma-mec-7)","Bm12766"]
assigned=[4,2,2,2]
pe=[3,3,3,3]
cdna=[1,0,0,0]          # independently cloned full cDNA in GenBank (AY705382, UniProt Q66T51, PE=2)
fieldgt=[3,0,0,0]       # field-isolate "beta-tubulin isotype 1" survey sequences assigning here
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.6))
x=np.arange(4); w=0.27
ax[0].bar(x-w,assigned,w,label="GenBank nucleotide records\nassigned by 8-mer margin",color="#3b6ea5")
ax[0].bar(x,cdna,w,label="independently cloned full cDNA",color="#c25a3c")
ax[0].bar(x+w,fieldgt,w,label='field-isolate "isotype 1"\nsurvey sequences',color="#6a9a4c")
ax[0].set_xticks(x); ax[0].set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=8); ax[0].set_ylabel("records")
ax[0].set_title("Transcript and survey evidence per B. malayi beta-tubulin locus",fontsize=10)
ax[0].legend(fontsize=7.5)
ax[1].axis("off")
txt=("UniProt protein existence level, all four loci: PE=3 (inferred from homology)\n"
     "Q66T51 (AY705382 cDNA, same locus as bma-ben-1, 99.8% identity): PE=2 (transcript level)\n\n"
     "EBI Expression Atlas: 0 Brugia malayi experiments (checked programmatically)\n"
     "WormBase ParaSite REST: no isotype-resolved expression table retrieved\n\n"
     "Isotype-resolved stage-specific expression for the four loci could NOT be\n"
     "obtained programmatically. No isotype is shown to be stage-restricted, and\n"
     "no isotype is excluded on expression grounds.")
ax[1].text(0.0,0.95,txt,va="top",fontsize=9,family="monospace")
ax[1].set_title("Expression resources checked",fontsize=10,loc="left")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
